import requests

def write_to_clipboard(data):
    with clipboard.OpenClipboard():
        clipboard.SetClipboardData(data)

def test():
    data = {"hello world!": "text"}
    write_to_clipboard(data)
    with open('data.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(data, f)
